title: 柴达木盆地｜汇水区参照

source.citation: 桂东伟, 林敬梧, 王颢霖, 李希明, 刘闯. 柴达木盆地汇水区绿洲、水系及高程分类数据集[J/DB/OL]. 全球变化数据仓储电子杂志(中英文), 2023. https://doi.org/10.3974/geodb.2023.10.08.V1.
source.download_method: Normal public download link presented by the dataset page; no login or restricted-access bypass.
source.source_data_description: Based on Google Earth images, ASTER GDEM 30 m and field measurements, according to the institutional metadata. This does not establish boundary positional accuracy.

license.attribution: 桂东伟、林敬梧、王颢霖、李希明、刘闯（2023）；全球变化科学研究数据出版系统；干旱区生态与资源科学数据中心
license.changes: Reconstructed one closed ring from 32 source LineStrings; merged duplicate joining endpoints, including two floating point tails; simplified for drawing in metric projection and reprojected to WGS84.
license.general_ten_percent_policy: Not used as the authorization basis. A smaller fraction of the source archive size alone is not evidence of compliance with a policy concerning the contents of a new dataset.

boundary_nature.context_note: The broad natural landform basin is commonly described at about 250,000 km². Do not compare areas as if they were the same boundary, or scale this catchment to that number.
boundary_nature.unavailable_preferred_dataset: NCDC 朱高峰 柴达木盆地矢量边界数据集（2021年）, about 240,000 km²; login to access, not obtained or substituted.

reconstruction.coordinate_system: WGS84 / EPSG:4326; longitude, latitude; altitude omitted
reconstruction.endpoint_matching: Match endpoints rounded to 9 decimal places for comparison only; retain first encountered source coordinate; reverse segments as necessary; omit their duplicate joining endpoint.

drawing.method: Douglas-Peucker topology-preserving simplification using Shapely in a local Azimuthal Equidistant projection centered at 94°E, 37°N, then transformed back to WGS84.
